name: Sessions
description: Terminal and structured agent sessions in a worktree.

method.description: Sessions, optionally only those of one worktree.

worktree.description: Only sessions in this worktree (selector, or `floating`); omitted lists all.

agent.description: `shell` or the ID of the agent the session runs.

exitCode.description: The exit code, or null while the process is alive.

exitSignal.description: The signal that ended the process, or null.

exitCause.description: Why the session ended (exited, killed, host-restart or host-lost), or null while it is alive.

restorable.description: True when the session ended with the PTY host and can be restored.

launch.description: What the session launched with ({command, args, env}); null for a shell or a session recorded before launches were kept.

launchSettings.description: What the launch applied ({agent, options, args, summary}); null when it applied nothing.

providerSession.description: The agent CLI's own session ({id, transcriptPath}) that resume passes back; null until one is stored.

promptDelivery.description: How the first prompt reached the agent: null (no prompt), command-line, pending, pasted, unconfirmed or not-delivered.

resumedFrom.description: The session this one was resumed or forked from; null otherwise.

agentStatus.description: The agent-status summary ({state, display, label, detail, progress, stateStartedAt, evidenceAt, restoredUnconfirmed}) the window draws; null or absent when no agent has reported one.

unread.description: Why the session is marked unread: `agent`, `bell` or `notification`; null or absent when it is not.

badges.description: Chips on the session's tab, keyed `<plugin id>/<key>`; each is {label, tooltip?, command?, args?}. Absent when there are none.

method.description: Starts a terminal session. `agent` defaults to the default agent (else the first installed one, else a shell). `prompt` reaches the agent the way that agent takes it; `promptDelivery` on the result says how. A prompt pasted after start settles later and emits `changed`, unless `waitForPrompt` is set. `title` names the tab; `command` runs one shell command instead of an interactive shell (agent shell only)

worktree.description: Worktree selector, or `floating` for the workspace outside any repository; default: the caller's current worktree.

agent.description: `shell` or an agent ID; default: the default agent.

prompt.description: The first prompt for the agent.

submitPrompt.description: With false the prompt is left in the agent's input without Enter; default true.

waitForPrompt.description: Return only after a pasted prompt has settled; default false.

title.description: Tab title; numbered like the default titles when taken

command.description: For agent shell only: a shell command string run under the login shell instead of an interactive shell; the session exits with its exit code

model.description: Model to launch the agent with (1 to 128 characters); a shell takes none. Checked against the agent's catalog.

options.description: Option picks for the model, such as {effort: "high"}: up to 16 entries whose values are strings or booleans. Needs `model`.

extraArgs.description: Extra agent arguments the agent's allowlist permits, such as "--add-dir docs".

cwd.description: Absolute directory the session starts in; default: the worktree path.

agent.description: `shell` or the ID of the agent the session runs.

exitSignal.description: The signal that ended the process, or null.

cli-command.summary: start a session (any agent from `quirky agents list`, or shell); --background runs a structured session

agent.description: agent ID to start (default: the default agent)

cwd.description: folder to start in (default: the worktree path)

wait.description: wait until the prompt is delivered and print the outcome

draft.description: leave the prompt in the agent's input without submitting it

model.description: model to launch the agent with

effort.description: effort level for the model; needs --model

option.description: another model option as KEY=VALUE; needs --model

extra-args.description: extra agent arguments, such as "--add-dir docs" (terminal sessions only)

cli-command.summary: resume an agent session in its original folder; --fork opens a copy

provider-session.description: the agent CLI's session ID (default: the one stored on the session)

transcript.description: transcript file, for agents that resume from one

fork.description: open a copy of the session instead of continuing it
